item.title: Revealed: The business category with the highest rate of failure
item.description: Australia's cafes and restaurants face rising insolvency risk as 10.4 per cent of food service businesses closed in the past year. The post Revealed: The business category with the highest rate of failure appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Small business and productivity ‘central’ to economic future, Cosboa says
item.description: “Productivity is central to the national economic discussion,” Cappuccio said. The post Small business and productivity ‘central’ to economic future, Cosboa says appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: NSW SMEs face double whammy after second Anzac Day holiday declared
item.description: For those operating on tight margins, an additional public holiday can influence staffing decisions and operational planning. The post NSW SMEs face double whammy after second Anzac Day holiday declared appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: New report reveals small businesses seen as ‘ripe fodder’ for cyber criminals
item.description: While ransomware remained the most common form of attack recorded, data‑only extortion incidents surged 1,100 per cent year-on-year. The post New report reveals small businesses seen as ‘ripe fodder’ for cyber criminals appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: The hidden cost of hustle
item.description: There is a growing body of empirical evidence showing that as an entrepreneur’s psychological capital increases, so too does their likelihood of business success. The post The hidden cost of hustle appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: AI threatens to eat business software – and it could change the way we work
item.description: Now new 'agentic' AI tools for business are expected to reduce reliance on traditional software for everyday work. The post AI threatens to eat business software – and it could change the way we work appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Small regional NSW roastery wins three awards at international coffee competition
item.description: Walcha Coffee received bronze medals across in all three categories it entered: Filter coffee; Espresso coffee; and Milk-Based coffee. The post Small regional NSW roastery wins three awards at international coffee competition appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Survey reveals how AI is saving time in workplace tasks
item.description: “Businesses still see the biggest opportunity in AI as removing repetitive admin-heavy tasks, communication and moving work forward without constant human intervention." The post Survey reveals how AI is saving time in workplace tasks appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: SME owners beware: Are you personally liable for these business decisions?
item.description: “Compliance should be viewed as risk management, not red tape.” The post SME owners beware: Are you personally liable for these business decisions? appeared first on Inside Small Business.
